name: drawdown_adaptive_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, large institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms create directional micro-trends detectable by Supertrend(2-min ATR) — when NIFTY is in a bullish Supertrend AND trading above session VWAP, buy-side program flow is dominant at multiple timescales and 30-60 second continuation is high-probability. The drawdown-adaptive layer tracks NIFTY's intraday session high-water mark: beyond 0.4% session drawdown, CE entries are suppressed (market is in a distribution/sell-program regime where Supertrend bullish whipsaws are common), and beyond 0.7% session drawdown all entries halt (index is in stress/liquidation mode where the signal degrades entirely). This regime filter mirrors the original's anti-martingale logic — during index drawdown, the order book skews bearish and a Supertrend long is fighting institutional flow.

indicators.name: supertrend_24
indicators.purpose: 24 bars = 2-minute ATR, chosen because: original used ATR(10) on 1-min bars (10 min of price action) for a 15-60 min hold. At 5s bars holding 30-120s, we compress to 2-min ATR to match the signal horizon to the hold time. A 10-min ATR would react too slowly to 30s micro-trends. The 2-min period captures institutional order-flow driven micro-swings while filtering 1-bar noise.

indicators.name: vwap_session
indicators.formula: cumsum(close * volume) / cumsum(volume) from session open
indicators.purpose: Cumulative from session open — no scaling needed. VWAP benchmarks the dominant execution algo fill price for the session. Price above VWAP = buy programs are getting better-than-benchmark fills (bullish pressure); below = sell programs dominate.

indicators.name: session_drawdown_pct
indicators.purpose: Session HWM is cumulative from 09:20. No scaling needed — it tracks the NIFTY intraday regime quality. Thresholds (0.4%, 0.7%) derived from original's % drawdown thresholds (0.3%, 0.6%, 1.0%) slightly compressed because index moves faster than individual equity.

conditions: Supertrend trend direction == bullish (close > supertrend lower band)
Supertrend bullish for 2+ consecutive bars (persistence filter against 5s spikes)
close > session VWAP (buy programs dominant, getting above-benchmark fills)
session_drawdown_pct < 0.40% (index has not entered distribution regime)
Supertrend trend direction == bearish (close < supertrend upper band)
session_drawdown_pct < 0.70% (not in full liquidation mode where signals degrade)

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option pts (~8 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5): a valid Supertrend micro-trend should not retrace 8 spot pts within 30 seconds of entry — if it does, the trend signal has failed (institutional order flow reversed). At 2-minute hold, NIFTY typically moves 3-7 option pts; a 4pt stop gives 1:1.75 R:R to the 7pt target.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option pts (~14 NIFTY spot pts): NIFTY institutional TWAP micro-trends carry 15-25 spot pts over 1-2 minutes when Supertrend and VWAP align. Targeting 7 pts captures ~50% of the expected continuation move, balancing hit rate vs magnitude.

filters.vix_filter: none (VIX not used; drawdown_pct acts as volatility/stress proxy)
filters.volume_filter: none (NIFTY index volume is noisy at 5s; signal quality from Supertrend + VWAP alignment instead)
filters.trend_filter: session_drawdown_pct thresholds act as regime filter (0.4% = CE off, 0.7% = all off)
filters.spread_filter: limit orders at close price — no spread cost (per execution model)

edge.edge_decay_risk: Moderate — Supertrend + VWAP is widely used; edge is in the drawdown-regime filter which is less commonly implemented at 5s. If NIFTY regime shifts to more ranging days (low trend autocorrelation), signal quality drops.

adaptation_notes: Original strategy's position sizing engine (reduce lots at 0.3%/0.6%/1.0% drawdown) cannot be directly represented in OptionSignals (which has fixed stop/target arrays, not per-trade lot scaling). Instead, the drawdown logic is converted to a SIGNAL GATE: at 0.4% session drawdown, CE entries suppressed (mirrors the original's 0.3% threshold for 25% size cut — effectively cutting CE signal to zero); at 0.7% session drawdown all signals halt (mirrors 1.0% daily loss limit but using index price level rather than P&L). The underlying Supertrend + VWAP signal is preserved but compressed from ATR(10, 1-min) = 10-min lookback to ATR(24, 5s) = 2-min lookback to match the 30-120s hold horizon. Trailing stop and signal exit (Supertrend flip) from original are replaced by time_stop_bars=24 (120s max hold), which is simpler and appropriate for 5s bars.
weaknesses: Session drawdown tracks NIFTY price level, not actual P&L from trades — a whipsaw session where NIFTY drops 0.4% then recovers will suppress CE entries during the recovery (the very period when original strategy would be re-entering at full size)
Supertrend at 2-min ATR may whipsaw during the first 5-10 minutes of session before sufficient ATR warmup (24 bars = 2 min); first few signals of the day are lower quality
VWAP filter is redundant with Supertrend direction for most bars — adding it reduces trade count without proportionally improving accuracy in range-bound sessions
